name: Regular I - Slot Left - 39 Pitch Pass
call: Regular I Slot Left 39 Pitch Pass

QB.rule: Pitch it exactly the way you pitch the toss, then run right like you still have it. Do not turn and watch the throw.

TB.rule: Catch the pitch and run the toss. At our end, pull up behind the line and throw it up the sideline to the tight end.

LTE.rule: Block the end the way you do on the toss, then slip outside him and run up the sideline. Look back over your outside shoulder.

FB.rule: Bubble outside our end the same as the toss and take the first man out there. He is the one who gets to the thrower.

coaching_points: Everything is the toss until he pulls up. Same pitch, same path, same speed -- a tailback who slows down to throw has told them.
He throws from behind the line. Crossing it is a penalty, so drill the pull-up, not the arm.
The tight end blocks the end first and then slips outside him. That block is what the toss shows them, and it is what gets him loose.
Call it after the toss has hurt them, on first or second down, where an incompletion costs nothing.
